summary: Meta published a CEO-authored essay articulating a philosophy of distributing 'personal superintelligence' broadly to individuals rather than concentrating it in institutions, describing planned personal AI agents, free and paid access tiers, and commitments around data center community investment and power infrastructure.

mechanisms.reason: Meta states it builds its own energy-generating infrastructure at the sites where it invests in data centers.
mechanisms.quote: We help keep electricity prices low by building our own energy-generating infrastructure wherever we invest.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes an active large data center build-out in Richland Parish, Louisiana, tied to local tax revenue effects.
mechanisms.quote: in Richland Parish, Louisiana, where Meta is building a large data center, teachers received a $50,000 bonus this year because of the increased tax revenue from our investment.

mechanisms.reason: Meta states it intends to make free AI access available to billions of people plus a paid compute tier, implying large-scale future usage growth.
mechanisms.quote: We will offer free versions that will be accessible to billions of people.

mechanisms.reason: The essay describes a vision of personal agents operating continuously on a user's behalf across many life domains, though this is aspirational rather than a stated deployed shift.
mechanisms.quote: Everyone will have an exceptionally capable personal agent that understands you, your goals, and everything you care about. Your agent will work 24/7 on your behalf to improve your relationships, health, career, finances, home management, hobbies, and more.
